blurb: Bright and curious. A speck of dust with big dreams.
tips: Ctrl+R searches your history as you type.
`cd -` jumps back to the previous folder.
`sudo !!` reruns the last command with sudo.
Ctrl+A / Ctrl+E: start / end of the line.
Ctrl+W deletes the word before the cursor.
personal: I'm made of stardust. And a bit of bash.
